title: SWAP5-Groundwater Coupling Temporal Error Budget, Window Convergence and Predictor-Corrector Qualification
purpose: Qualify only the temporal/coupling contribution to SWAP5-groundwater interface error. Do not choose or imply an application head-accuracy requirement and do not retroactively modify F-GC06.
frozen_questions: How do interface head and flux errors vary with coupling-window DeltaT?
What empirical convergence order is visible without assuming an order a priori?
How does SWAP internal temporal refinement change error at fixed coupling-window DeltaT?
How do predictor-only and predictor-corrector paths compare?
How many corrector iterations are needed in the controlled test classes?
When does coupling-window error dominate SWAP internal integration error and vice versa?
Can a practical temporal/coupling estimator be constructed from independent observable quantities?
Can dh_bottom/dq_bottom reduce corrector cost or improve stability when the source-bound capability exists?

experiment_policy.controlled_groundwater_component: independent deterministic simple aquifer response model
experiment_policy.window_family: multiple physically meaningful and approximately log-spaced DeltaT values, including non-daily and non-midnight windows
experiment_policy.temporal_reference: strongly refined numerical reference; explicitly not physical truth
experiment_policy.cost_accounting: SWAP trials, groundwater updates, nonlinear iterations, linear solves, retries and corrector iterations where observable

literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.use: iterative versus non-iterative saturated-unsaturated coupling; coupling-step convergence as case-specific evidence

literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.source: Beegum et al. 2018, Vadose Zone Journal
literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.use: stepwise groundwater-head exchange can introduce bottom-flux artefacts; separate internal vadose stepping from groundwater/coupling step

literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.source: Kyllingstad, Sadjina and Skjong 2025, Simulation Modelling Practice and Theory 145, 103209
literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.use: co-simulation macro-step error estimation and adaptive step-size control
predictor-corrector difference as candidate local macro-step error estimator

literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.source: USGS MODFLOW 6 Description of Input and Output, ATS utility
literature_priors_not_acceptance_thresho.use: independent precedent for shrinking/growing internal groundwater time steps from numerical behavior; not an application error budget

fail_closed_rule: If the controlled evidence cannot separate coupling-window error from SWAP internal temporal error, cannot preserve hard interface mass, or cannot support an estimator/window policy without target tuning, close with an explicit blocker and no numeric A_temporal coefficient.
